description: This file defines the Vtiger_StringTemplate class which provides functionality for managing string templates with variable placeholders, including assigning variables, merging templates, and replacing variables with values.

classes.name: Vtiger_StringTemplate
classes.description: A class for handling string templates with dynamic variable replacements, including methods for assigning, retrieving, clearing, and merging template variables.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a value to a template variable identified by a key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a template variable by its key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all template variables, optionally preserving specified variables.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges a template string with the assigned variables, performing variable substitution unless avoided.

methods.name: __formatAsRegex
methods.description: Private method to format a string as a regex pattern, escaping '/' and '$'.
